46:29.text: listening to the Qur’ân. When they stood in the presence thereof, they said: "Listen in silence!" And when it was finished, they returned to their people, as warners.

46:30.text: They said: "O our people! Verily, we have heard a Book
, confirming what came before it: it guides to the truth and to the Straight Path

46:31.text: (i.e. Allâh’s Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
(i.e. believe in that which Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم has brought from Allâh and follow him)
will forgive you of your sins, and will save you from a painful torment

46:32.text: And whosoever does not respond to Allâh’s Caller, he cannot escape on earth, and there will be no Auliyâ’

46:33.text: Do they not see that Allâh, Who created the heavens and the earth, and was not wearied by their creation, is Able to give life to the dead? Yes, He surely is Able to do all things.

46:34.text: And on the Day when those who disbelieve will be exposed to the Fire
: "Is this not the truth?" They will say: "Yes, By our Lord!" He will say: "Then taste the torment, because you used to disbelieve!"

46:35.text: as did the Messengers of strong will
and be in no haste about them
. On the Day when they will see that
as if they had not stayed more than an hour in a single day.
(O mankind! this Qur’ân is sufficient as)
(or proclamation to save yourself from destruction)
. But shall any be destroyed except the people who are Al-Fâsiqûn
(the rebellious against Allâh’s Command, the disobedient to Allâh)
